summary: Shred and Rip cat with Shifting Power for Energy and Berserk on cooldown, no Rake. Forever's form rules apply: the cat swings its weapon's DPS at 1.0 s, and stones, potions, Thistle Tea and Windfury Totem all work in Cat Form. It is the talent search's best on the synthetic Phase 1 gear and the default Feral Level 60 preset.
rotation: Opener: plain Cat Form (no Stealth/Prowl or Ravage)
Racials, trinkets and potions on cooldown; Berserk with the on-use trinket; Elune's Light outside Berserk
Shifting Power at 50 Energy or less, unless a Ferocious Bite is due (5 CP and Rip has 6 s or more)
Ferocious Bite at any combo points in the last 2 s
Rip at 4+ combo points when it is down (not in the last 8 s)
Ferocious Bite at 5 combo points and 35 Energy while Rip has 6 s or more left (or in the last 8 s)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 29 Agility and 17 Strength, and 165 Strength for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Rip's level 31+ client ranks are 6-9% below Era: Era values would give +1.6%
Howling Idol is worth 12.5 and 5-piece Grovekeeper Ferocity would add 5.9 (measured before the 5a and 1b rounds)
Unverified: Shred's flat bonus, AP on Rip and Ferocious Bite, Rend and Tear's scope
Keeping Rake up costs 33; Rip at 5 CP ties
Only one +2% crit elixir by standard; Grizzly in place of Ferocity would add 4.9
Tiger's Fury is removed in Forever (replaced by Shifting Power); it was worth 24.9 at 180 s
The cat's swing spreads 20% either side of the weapon's DPS (the server's range isn't visible)
Windfury Totem in the melee group is +13.3 over Grace of Air; Dense Weightstone on the mace is +4.9 (Elemental Sharpening Stone left out: its plans only drop in Molten Core)
notes: Request from mksettings -spec feral (melee group: Strength of Earth and Grace of Air regular, all blessings, own Leader of the Pack; latency 100 ms). Duration 180 s, durationVariation 20. Potion and Demonic Rune are in the consumes but do nothing in Cat Form. No edits needed.
